newsitem.title: CHINA: Diesel Engine to list more B shares.
newsitem.headline: Diesel Engine to list more B shares.

text.p: Shanghai Diesel Engine Co Ltd will list an additional 85 million B shares on Thursday on the Shanghai stock exchange, a company statement said on Tuesday.

The shares were sold earlier this month in a rights issue at a price of 3.36 yuan ($0.405) per share and proceeds will be used to expand the company's production, the statement published in the Shanghai Securities News said.
The company's B shares listed in Shanghai closed at $0.540 per share on Monday.
The statement said after the rights issue, the number of the company's B shares had increased to 217 million shares, accounting for 45.18 percent of its total 480.3 million outstanding shares.
Domestic A shares accounted for 4.5 percent and the remaining 50.32 percent shares were owned by the state, the statement said.
